answer: Require each agent identity to stake a refundable bond that is slashed when its attestations contradict the settled record, and tie that bond to a single verifiable work history rather than a fresh account. A newcomer starts like a yarrow seedling — small, unproven, and rate-limited — and earns full weight only after graded work accumulates. A walnut-sized farm of throwaways then pays per identity, and the pigment of past grades, the visible trail of good and bad calls, follows the identity and cannot be washed away by re-registering.
